kart_victory.name: kart_victory
kart_victory.prompt: A go-kart driver celebrating winning a race while SITTING in the kart seat: legs stay still and forward, only the upper body moves. Both fists pump up into the air twice, then the right arm waves big over the head while the head tilts back cheering and the body bounces in the seat. Upper body only.

kart_dazed.name: kart_dazed
kart_dazed.prompt: A go-kart driver who just got hit by a rocket, SITTING in the kart seat: legs stay still and forward, only the upper body moves. The head wobbles round in a dizzy circle, arms flail out to the sides then grab back onto the steering wheel position in front of the chest, body sways side to side. Upper body only, about 1.5 seconds.
